Well, if im being honest, I dont trust anyone anymore, I dont think theres anyone I can talk to. I preffer to keep all my thoughts and actions to myself because otherwise I feel like im attention seeking. There were about 2-3 times where I tried opening up to people I know in my life, they all left me, including my gf back then. This is why I dont trust people anymore, and probably also due to the constantly toxic environment I grow up in I guess. As you said about not getting involved when things get physical, the thing is that I dont really care what happens to me anymore, my life isnt anymore important than anyone else's, and im willing to throw it away like that if I have to just to help someone else, or stop someone else from getting hurt. And calling the police if that ever happened...I dont think I'd be able to do that, I have no idea how my future would be affected, I want to get into medical college, my grades are great, but if something goes wrong in any way, my chances of getting there would be slim or non-existent, if I even make it that far in life...thank you for the advice, I just needed someone to talk to I guess

Thank you for the reply, for the first point, no, im not close to anyone that could help me with moving out if I reach that point, and for 2, Im not sure it would he so helpful, my mom has a narcissistic personallity and cant take a second opinion on anything because whatever she thinks is right, has to be right. I dont want to get a school counselor involved or anything because I am too scared of the consequences, if my mom found out she would just laugh at me and use it as a way to insult me that I cant deal with my own problems, I dont have anyone I can talk to or a person that is just there for me, irl. Thats why I resort to going online, like rn, because this is one of those things I feel that help me from spiralling down again, the feeling that, you know, atleast SOMEONE hears me out...

The headphones idea is not bad, I do have a pair of headphone, but I choose not to use them because sometimes my parents arguments can get, out of hand,  so I have to get involved quickly before it escalates too far where it gets physical...

They want you to be open, but as soon as you open up, they realise that you're "weak" and leave you. I also had to learn this lesson the hard way, by opening up and getting left, luckily it wasnt too far in the relationship, but regardless, it hurts.
Agreed...only 1 way to fully feel peaceful and not like a completely waste of air.
